notablePrerequisites: NOTE: This combo fails if two of the top six cards of your library share a name.
description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to gain seven life and put Approach of the Second Sun into your library seventh from the top.
Cast Tainted Pact by paying {1}{B}, exiling cards from the top of your library until you exile Approach of the Second Sun, putting it into your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, causing you to win the game.
